decision_summary: QIF v0.6.20 Package Types Manifest CLI is release-ready.
rationale: The change exposes package type selection data as machine-readable JSON with templates, validators, lifecycle roles, and verifier boundaries; it passed package-types, commands, doctor, validation, and npm test verification.
recommendation: Release v0.6.20 and keep schema export, remote registry publication, and semantic package recommendation for later slices.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, and harness authors
expected_user_reaction: Users and agents can choose the correct QIF package shape without relying on hidden conversation context or prose-only documentation.
